WITH w AS (
         SELECT wk.id, wsa.location
         FROM workers wk
         JOIN worker_service_areas wsa ON wsa.worker_id = wk.id AND wsa.deleted_at IS NULL
         WHERE wk.id = $2
           AND wsa.location IS NOT NULL
           AND NOT (wsa.latitude = 0 AND wsa.longitude = 0)
         ORDER BY wsa.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1
       )
       SELECT jp.id,
              jp.case_number,
              jp.vacancy_number,
              jp.title,
              p.service_type AS service,
              COALESCE(pa.neighborhood, p.zone_neighborhood) AS neighborhood,
              pa.city AS city,
              pa.state AS state,
              CASE WHEN jp.contracted_service_id IS NOT NULL THEN horario_do_servico(jp.contracted_service_id, CURRENT_DATE) ELSE jp.schedule END AS schedule,
              CASE WHEN jp.contracted_service_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pcs_eff.required_professions, '{}'::text[]) ELSE jp.required_professions END AS worker_type,
              ROUND((d.meters / 1000)::numeric, 1) AS distance_km,
              (SELECT wja.applied_at FROM worker_job_applications wja WHERE wja.worker_id = $2 AND wja.job_posting_id = jp.id) AS applied_at,
              EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM worker_job_applications wja WHERE wja.worker_id = $2 AND wja.job_posting_id = jp.id) AS already_applied
       FROM job_postings jp
       LEFT JOIN patient_contracted_services pcs_eff ON pcs_eff.id = jp.contracted_service_id
       CROSS JOIN w
       JOIN patient_addresses pa ON pa.id = jp.patient_address_id
       LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.id = jp.patient_id
       CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
         SELECT ST_Distance(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(pa.lng::float8, pa.lat::float8), 4326)::geography, w.location) AS meters
       ) d
       WHERE pa.lat IS NOT NULL AND pa.lng IS NOT NULL
         AND ST_DWithin(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(pa.lng::float8, pa.lat::float8), 4326)::geography, w.location, $3 * 1000)
         AND jp.deleted_at IS NULL
         AND COALESCE((SELECT w_realm_chk.is_test FROM workers w_realm_chk WHERE w_realm_chk.id = w.id), false) = COALESCE((SELECT jp_realm_chk.is_test FROM job_postings jp_realm_chk WHERE jp_realm_chk.id = jp.id), false)
         AND (NOT (COALESCE(jp.is_test, false) = false) OR ((jp.deleted_at IS NULL
         AND jp.is_draft = false
         AND jp.is_test = false
         AND jp.status NOT IN ('DE_BAJA', 'CLOSED', 'ON_HOLD', 'SUSPENDED')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_contracted_services pcs_pub WHERE pcs_pub.id = jp.contracted_service_id AND pcs_pub.active = false)
         AND COALESCE(p.status, '') NOT IN ('ON_HOLD', 'SUSPENDED', 'ALTA', 'DISCHARGED'))
         AND jp.social_short_links ? 'site'
         AND jp.country = $1))
       ORDER BY d.meters ASC, jp.id ASC
